publish_job_rehearsal.workflow: .github/workflows/release-please.yml job publish-crossplane, without docker login and without the publish target
publish_job_rehearsal.clean_copy: git clone of the local repository checked out at source_git_commit, submodules initialized, umask 022 as on GitHub runners
commands: make -C crossplane build.all PLATFORMS="linux_amd64 linux_arm64" XPKG_REG_ORGS="xpkg.upbound.io/archestra" TERRAFORM_PROVIDER_VERSION=3.0.0 VERSION=v3.0.0
publish_job_rehearsal.qemu: arm64 image build needs emulation, which the real job provides with docker/setup-qemu-action. Here it was enabled with docker run --privileged --rm tonistiigi/binfmt --install arm64; docker run --platform linux/arm64 alpine uname -m then printed aarch64. Without it the arm64 RUN step fails with exec format error.
publish_job_rehearsal.release_fixture: The 3.0.0 release zips do not exist yet. Release-style zips (goreleaser naming and flags, built at source_git_commit) were served from a temporary loopback fixture through TERRAFORM_PROVIDER_DOWNLOAD_URL_PREFIX=http://127.0.0.1:18765, which the Makefile accepts as an override. No published release assets were used or claimed.

build: Shipping runtime Dockerfile, Alpine 3.23.4, non-root uid 65532, Terraform 1.5.7, provider 3.0.0, VERSION=v3.0.0.
reconciliation_scope: Environment create/update/delete in both scopes using each actual Linux runtime image as an in-cluster Deployment (arm64 under QEMU) with its bundled Terraform and native provider; backend 404 after delete. This checks runtime packaging; it is not a full-family test for each architecture. The host-run controller was stopped during these checks.
crd_count_note: 67 CRDs = 31 resources in two scopes plus five provider configuration CRDs (the rc.48 record had 75 for 35 families).
environment_note: A first rehearsal in this pod ran with umask 0077, which made the binaries copied into the image mode 0700 and the controller not executable for uid 65532 under Docker (controller --help: permission denied). That is a property of the build host, not of the repository; GitHub runners use umask 022. The repeated run recorded here used umask 022.
publication: Not published. No registry push, docker login, release or tag operation was performed.
